name: Cloudflare
author: mdick85
description: Your Cloudflare account in the bar: what is broken, the last 24 hours of traffic, every resource, and links to live sites.

barWidget.description: See problems, analytics and recent deploys. Open any domain, Worker, Pages project, bucket or database in the dashboard or on its live site.

schema.label: Account ID
schema.description: Which account to show. Empty means the first one. Press a in the panel to switch.

schema.label: Resource refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often to load resources and deploys.

schema.label: Projects folder
schema.description: Where to look for wrangler projects, for deploy and roll back. Empty means ~/Projects.

schema.label: Worker invocations per day allowance
schema.description: Adds a bar to the invocations card. 0 means not set.

schema.label: R2 storage allowance (GB)
schema.description: Adds a bar to the R2 card. 0 means not set.

schema.label: D1 rows read per day allowance
schema.description: Shown on the D1 row. 0 means not set.

schema.label: Worker error rate warning (%)
schema.description: A Worker above this error rate needs attention.
